CustomField.label: Address
CustomField.description: ★R8 SEIM_PERSON.ADDR. One field, not five, matching the reference ERD. A custom object has no compound address type, so the alternative was inventing street / city / state / postcode / country columns the source data does not separate — that would produce five mostly-empty fields and a false promise that the address is structured enough to sort or map on. Text Area rather than Long Text so it stays usable in report filters.
